chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which is an explanation of the attributes of the Truth, may His majesty be glorified, then an exhortation of the people to piety and consultation.

key_terms.جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ: May His majesty be glorified (an honorific for God)

ai.seo_question: What are the key themes of Imam Ali's sermon regarding God's attributes and human conduct?
ai.summary: In this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the theological foundation of God's attributes before transitioning to practical ethical guidance, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on linking creed (aqeedah) with conduct (akhlaq). The call to taqwa and musharah underscores the communal responsibility of the faithful, a theme central to the governance model advocated by the Ahl al-Bayt. This structure highlights how divine knowledge serves as the prerequisite for righteous action and collective decision-making.
